consumer_rule: Each input has its own timestamp and freshness (model, kalshi, reference, lineup, context). Recompute at READ time: a price is CURRENT only before its `action_valid_until` (= kalshi.current_until); after that treat it as STALE_PRICE / NO ACTION and run REFRESH SOCCER SLATE. Only action == ACTIONABLE permits a bet (bet_permitted). Every model family is RESEARCH_ONLY, so RESEARCH_CANDIDATE is analysis only. Never pair a probability from this file with a price from another file or another time.
